verdict.sufficient: yes on the normal path once requires land; partly on the edges (loop unavailable, lean runtime, fix plan 3.3 exits, concerns pointered)
verdict.necessary: yes, mostly (fresh-branch Contract/Receipt line and the Done-report fields line duplicate what the start command and the runtime print)
verdict.summary: Round 2's P0 and three P1s are fixed. The revisit block is excerpt-class with D3's bounds. The look-back skips only bookkeeping. criterion_evidence has fix plan 3.3's seven fields. KNOWLEDGE/ locators print, and requires is complete apart from IM3-08. Decision 20 holds on main's runtime: start, active done and stopped done each print Work, Exit and Repeat equal to the contract (verified by running 0.10.0). Every exit also has an operational line in the print, so a model knows what done means before it starts the loop. No gate anchor or rule was lost. The live Battleship install's lean runtime printed the exits only, which is exactly the regression E5 must catch, so E5 must test stdout, not the receipt. The one open P1 is the static budget at a real Grok-length install (19,758 > 19,500). The renderer would refuse that packet. Printing the Contract/Receipt line only once the loop has started fixes it (measured 19,441). Before porting, the prototype renderer needs one fix: after a shrink it re-renders the pool from its spent remainder, which turns every anchor into a pointer. Ready to land once IM3-01 is fixed and requires names E5's stdout test and the stage_spec done_when change. The P2s (IM2-06, IM2-07, IM2-10, IM3-02, IM3-04, IM3-05, IM3-07) should land in the same commit, since each is a one-line or one-flag change.
top_changes: IM3-01 + IM3-02: print 'Contract: · Receipt:' only in the loop_started branch (static 19,105/19,441, no shrink on a realistic revisit), and fix tmpl.render so a shrink re-renders the pool from its starting size, not its spent remainder.

Make decision 20 safe: E5 asserts on printed stdout of start, active done, terminal done and next (IM3-06); requires adds fix plan 3.3's stage_spec done_when (IM3-08); add a loop_ready flag that prints the done_when list and 'Unavailable: ... report blocked' (IM3-05).

Keep the step's obligations and routes right: concerns before R-n in the anchors pool (IM3-04); 'send-back' in the considerations appendix (IM3-07); no start command in the step-proof refusal under check-only, and the loop_started guard 'when the receipt is complete or stopped' (IM2-06).
